description: This file defines the Customer class for the OpenCart admin dashboard extension. It manages the customer dashboard widget, including displaying customer statistics, saving configuration settings, and rendering views related to customers.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class for the customer dashboard widget, handling display, configuration saving, and customer data retrieval.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Prepares data for the customer dashboard widget view, including breadcrumbs, configuration, and layout components, then renders the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving dashboard configuration settings, including permission checks and JSON response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Gathers customer statistics such as total customers and daily changes, then renders the customer information view.
